Cogram (YC W22, https://cogram.com) | Multiple Roles | Remote or hybrid (US/EU/UK) | Full-time

Cogram builds AI agents for architects and engineers. Our tools automate project management and streamline CAD/BIM for leading firms around the world. We have engaged customers using our products day-to-day on real projects and are growing fast.

We're hiring across GTM and Product/Engineering:

  · Growth Lead / GTM engineer and early-stage marketers: technically strong and excellent writers.

  · Designers that code, PMs that have strong design skills, or design-savvy engineers

  · Account Executives: based in US East/Central or UK. At least two years of exceeding targets in software sales.

  · Builders and former founders: strong at talking to users, understanding requirements, and shipping features end-to-end.
For all roles please see: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/cogram/jobs

We offer:

  · Work directly with customers using our tools daily on architecture, engineering, and construction projects.

  · Build differentiated products with real traction at the intersection of software, the physical world, and design.

  · A deeply focused, high-caliber team.
If you’re applying for a GTM role (GTM Engineer or AE), email alex - at - cogram - dot - com with subject: Cogram GTM Application 0526

We’d love to hear from you.
